text:
amanda: Quick sync  short proposal for error ergonomics in SDKs: compact by default, verbose opt-in, explicit fields to avoid guessing.
priya: Agree. Minimal compact payload: code + status (+ retry_after if present). Verbose adds message, user_message, user_action, retryable, retry_hint, meta/docs_url.
jason: SDKs should map into typed exceptions (e.g., AuthTokenExpired) exposing user_message and a helper .shouldRetry() that prefers explicit retryable when present, otherwise follows HTTP fallback.
lucas: Fallback rules we should document: 429 -> retryable=true unless explicitly false; 5xx -> retryable=true; 4xx -> retryable=false unless retry_hint or retryable=true. Add tests.
emily: Sample apps: always surface user_message (<=140 chars) and show internal message only in a collapsible "details" when verbose. Map user_action -> CTA label.
amanda: Action items: Priya to open API PR for user_message/user_action/retryable + X-Error-Detail header; SDK leads to implement typed exceptions + parity tests; DevEx updates sample-apps. Aim to land API + docs this week.
